title: Cultural background and mallworlds?
content: Recently discovered this sub and can certainly relate to the experiences of recurring places, but curiously enough, it's never a mall for me, possibly because I've never been to one until my teenage years. I wonder how much of those dreams are informed by our childhood experience, my theory being that malls are just very exciting and therefore memorable for a child growing up in the west, and if there's someone who wasn't exposed to them that much throughout childhood would simply have other dream spaces. I grew up in Eastern Europe and tend to dream of empty cities with commie blocks. The recurrent feeling is that I'm lost and need to go home, but it's getting dark, and I seem to have forgotten which way I should go. There are usually other people in my dreams, yet the dreams feel incredibly lonesome, and most of the time I can't even remember who was exactly was there with me. Since I mostly see Americans posting here, I wonder if there's anyone with an Eastern European background who can relate. Attaching some images from Pinterest that seem to convey the vibe. *Processing img 34wkein2vzzc1...*
